decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch with its own page in both years, this line shows visible commitment and a strong fit with the firm's core skincare range, so management is likely to persist unless results clearly deteriorate.

The serum fits the established offer and remains on the site, but its lower visibility than Product A suggests a somewhat weaker public commitment, making it more droppable if space or resources become tight.

Because this cleansing oil was only launched in 2024 and sits close to the firm's core business, management is likely to give it more time and explain any weak early results as temporary rather than withdraw it quickly.
